name: ResetMatrixHomogeneous
evidence: zeroes the fourth word of a matrix's first three rows and sets its fourth row to D_0024B260 (CopyRotationMatrix and six others call it)

name: CopyRotationMatrix
evidence: copies a matrix's first three rows and resets the rest (ResetMatrixHomogeneous); returns the destination

name: MultiplyByTransposedMatrix3x3
evidence: writes each of the three rows of the second matrix as dot products with the three rows of the first (out = b times a transposed), on VU0; CopyRotationMatrix's neighbour, used by func_00128150 and func_0016C528

name: InitIdentityMatrix
evidence: clears 0x40 bytes and sets the four diagonal floats to 1.0

name: ScaleMatrix
evidence: multiplies all four rows of a matrix by one float into the output

name: MultiplyMatrices
evidence: original assembly: writes the product of two matrices (DrawC60Object multiplies its transform by its scale with it; TransformMatrixByObject and a dozen others call it)

name: TransformByMatrixWithW
evidence: x times row 0 plus y times row 1 plus z times row 2 plus the given w times row 3: a point (w 1) or a direction (w 0) through a matrix (TransformPointArray, DrawPathCurveSegment)

name: TransformVector4
evidence: multiplies a four-component vector by a 4x4 matrix and returns the result in a register (DrawTriangleGroups, DrawColoredTriangles)

name: CopyTransposedMatrix
evidence: copies four rows, then swaps m[i][j] with m[j][i] for i < j

name: AddMatrices
evidence: out[i] = a[i] + b[i] for 16 floats

name: BuildAxisAngleMatrix
evidence: sine and cosine of an angle, t*axis[i]*axis[j] plus cosine on the diagonal and the cross-product terms: the axis-angle rotation matrix

name: BuildRotationFromVector
evidence: a rotation about the vector's direction by its length (BuildAxisAngleMatrix), or the identity when it is shorter than 1e-4 (ApplyPropertyRecord)

name: BuildEulerRotationMatrix
evidence: takes the sine and cosine of three angles and fills the nine elements of a 3x3 rotation

name: BuildMatrixFromRotationAndTranslation
evidence: copies three rows of b with w = 0 and a as the fourth row with w = 1

name: InvertRigidTransform
evidence: from a translation and a rotation writes the inverse transform: the transposed rotation and the translation rotated by it and negated, with w 1 (SetVertexBatchTransform, BuildScaleAboutFrame)

name: BuildScaledTransformMatrix
evidence: multiplies each rotation row by a scale component, with the position as fourth row and w column 0, 0, 0, 1

name: GetMatrixRotationCosine
evidence: returns half of the matrix's trace less one, clamped to -1..1 (ClampToMagnitude): the cosine of its rotation's angle

name: MatrixToAxisAngle
evidence: finds the axis and angle of a rotation matrix from its trace ((m00+m11+m22-1)/2) and its diagonal, giving angle 0 about x when the cosine is above 0.999999 (ReadAxisRotationCurve)

name: MatrixToEulerAngles
evidence: asin of -m[2], and atan2 of other elements for the other two angles, with the singular case at +-1.5707

name: OrthonormalizeMatrix
evidence: normalises row 0, makes row 2 the normalised cross product of rows 0 and 1 and row 1 the normalised cross product of rows 2 and 0 (func_00121DE0, func_00125440 and func_001DDE90 call it)

name: MultiplyMatrices3x3
evidence: writes the product of two 3x3 matrices (rows of 16 bytes) on VU0 (ReadAxisRotationCurve)

name: TransformMatrixByObject
evidence: builds a matrix from the object's rotation and translation at +0x30 (func_00188B48), multiplies it with the argument (MultiplyMatrices) and copies the four rows out (TransformPointArray calls it)

name: VectorToAngles
evidence: atan2(y, x) and atan2(z, sqrt(x*x + y*y)) stored through the two output pointers

name: BuildYawPitchMatrix
evidence: multiplies a rotation by the yaw about z with one by the negated pitch about y (BuildAxisAngleMatrix twice) into a 3x3 matrix (GetTargetCameraControllerEyePosition)

name: BuildBasisFromX
evidence: BuildBasisFromXAndZHint with the unit z vector as the hint

name: InvertSquareMatrix
evidence: same elimination for n by n floats on a scratch copy taken between PushBackMemoryMark and PopBackMemoryMark; returns 0 when singular

name: InvertMatrix3x3
evidence: Gauss-Jordan elimination with row pivoting on a copy, starting from an identity table; returns 0 when a pivot is 0

name: InvertMatrix4x4
evidence: calls InvertSquareMatrix with dimension 4

name: BuildBasisFromXAndYHint
evidence: a rotation whose row 0 is the normalised x direction and row 2 the normalised cross product of it with the y hint (func_001ED840 when that is shorter than 1e-4); InvertMatrix4x4's neighbour, used by func_001A2D88

name: BuildBasisFromXAndZHint
evidence: a rotation whose row 0 is the normalised x direction and row 1 the normalised cross product of the z hint with it (row 2 from func_001ED840 when that is shorter than 1e-4)

name: BuildProjectionMatrix
evidence: clears 0x40 bytes and fills a, b, c, d, (e+f)/(e-f), e*(1-that) and 1.0 at fixed elements from six floats

name: BuildUniformScaleAboutPoint
evidence: BuildScaleAboutFrame about a point with no rotation and the same scale on all three axes (DrawC60Object, DrawTriangleGroups)

name: BuildScaleAboutFrame
evidence: builds the frame of a translation and a rotation (BuildMatrixFromRotationAndTranslation; the origin and the identity by default), its inverse (InvertRigidTransform) and a diagonal scale, and writes frame times scale times inverse (MultiplyMatrices)

name: BuildRotationBetweenVectors
evidence: the rotation that turns the first vector into the second, about their normalised cross product; the identity when either is shorter than 1e-4 (func_0016C528, func_001DDE90)
